name: Deniz Tabanı
scene: An elegant lobster raises its broad claws above a segmented body and fan tail among flowing underwater currents and kelp on the sea floor.
notes: Inspected both generations and selected the single correction pass. Lobster uses the warm pair and background uses the cool pair; no obvious loose-ended lines. Remaining doubts: subtle shading and teal variation persist, adjacent subject panes sometimes repeat a colour, several claw/body/background joins may be four-way, and narrow antenna/abdomen/leg-tip pieces need review. Raster component estimate is 205, above the 96–136 target; simplify background and nonessential subdivisions during tracing while preserving subject contours. This is a design sheet, not audited playable geometry or final glass artwork.

rasterReview.method: 4-connected saturated pixel components with max-minus-min >45 and max >85, area at least 150 pixels; approximate raster estimate, not vector audit.
